Still 8 all_reduce dispatches but fewer intermediate clones and loops. Trades code complexity for reduced memory bandwidth by batching element-wise operations.

strategies.name: Reduce-Scatter + All-Gather Pattern
strategies.desc: Replaces each all_reduce with a reduce_scatter (producing S-sized shard per rank) followed by local scaling, then all_gather to reconstruct full vector. 16 total dispatches (8×2) but smaller per-rank payload during reduce_scatter phase. Trades dispatch count for reduced per-dispatch communication volume, potentially better for bandwidth-constrained networks.

strategies.name: Pipelined Double-Buffered Computation
strategies.desc: Overlaps local computation (scaling operations) of iteration i with all_reduce communication of iteration i+1 using two alternating buffers. Requires careful dependency management across 8 stages. Still 8 all_reduce dispatches but hides local arithmetic latency behind network time, improving overall throughput on high-latency interconnects.

strategies.name: Hierarchical Two-Level Collective
strategies.desc:
Exploits potential node structure by performing intra-node reductions (if num_nodes>1) using smaller world_size collectives, then inter-node all_reduce, then intra-node broadcast for each of 8 stages. Reduces cross-node bandwidth pressure by aggregating within NUMA domains first. Total dispatches 8×3=24 but with heterogeneous payload sizes optimized for network topology.

    S = 256
    W = world_size

    a = [1.0 + 0.25 * (r % 5) for r in range(W)]
